serverInfo.name: corag-site
serverInfo.description: corag.org — the institutional site for Corag, el ecosistema de impacto social. Read-only agent surface over public site content. This host has NO write API: publishing a need or an offer, contributing, and tracking a contribution all happen at https://app.corag.org, which exposes its own public REST API, OpenAPI 3.1 spec and MCP server. Exposed via WebMCP in the browser and documented via Agent Skills at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.
